findings.description: The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so all objects (including the customer-master.xlsx file uploaded by aws_s3_bucket_object.data_object) are stored unencrypted at rest, exposing sensitive customer data if the underlying storage is compromised.

The configuration explicitly comments that this bucket is public while it stores customer master data; no public-read ACL or bucket policy is present in this file, so if the comment reflects the deployed state the customer-master.xlsx object is readable by any unauthenticated party.

The object upload does not set server_side_encryption and targets aws_s3_bucket.data, which has no default encryption, so the customer-master.xlsx file (sensitive customer data) is stored in cleartext at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so financial data stored here is unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so operations data stored here is unencrypted at rest.
The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration (confirmed by the inline comment), so data-science objects are stored unencrypted at rest.
